title: Buying a return ticket
instructions: Hannah istasyonda gidiş-dönüş bilet alıyor. Saat, peron ve fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: hannah
script.text: Hello. I'd like a return ticket to York, please.

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: OK. That's forty-two pounds. If you have a student card, it's thirty.

script.speaker: hannah
script.text: I'm not a student any more, unfortunately. When's the next train?

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: There's one at ten fifteen, but it's very slow. The ten forty is faster. It arrives at the same time.

script.speaker: hannah
script.text: Then I'll take the ten forty. Which platform?

script.speaker: hannah
script.text: Thanks. Is there a café on the train?

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: Yes, but it's quite expensive. You can buy a coffee here in the station.

questions.feedback: Artık öğrenci değil; kırk iki pound ödüyor.

questions.prompt: Why does Hannah take the ten forty train?
questions.feedback: 10:40 daha hızlı ve aynı saatte varıyor.

questions.prompt: Which platform does the train leave from?
What does the clerk say about the café on the train?
questions.feedback: Trende kafe var ama oldukça pahalı.
